items.title: Tech rally boosts Asian stocks, dollar firms on rate-hike wagers
items.author: Ankur Banerjee
items.creator: Ankur Banerjee
items.summary: Technology stocks powered Asian markets higher on Tuesday as stalling oil prices lifted sentiment and investors pinned their hopes on US-Iran talks, while the dollar stood tall on bets that more interest rate hikes are needed to rein in inflation.
items.body:
Technology stocks powered Asian markets higher on Tuesday as stalling oil prices lifted sentiment and investors pinned their hopes on US-Iran talks, while the dollar stood tall on bets that more interest rate hikes are needed to rein in inflation.
Strong demand for Meta Platform's (META.O) Muse AI assistant since its launch revived enthusiasm for the sector after safety warnings from leaders of AI bellwethers a week earlier triggered a global tech selloff.
MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan (.MISX00000PUS) hit a two-week high and was last up 0.75%. Tech-heavy South Korean stocks (.KS11) jumped 2% before paring gains, while Taiwan shares (.TWII) hit a record high and were last up 0.26%. Japanese markets were closed for a holiday.
"The excitement around Meta Muse is adding weight to the idea that millions of people could eventually use persistent AI agents," said Chris Weston, head of research at Pepperstone.
"The combination of Meta Muse injecting a new shot of confidence in the CPU demand profile, lower crude prices, falling Treasury yields and optimism towards the US-China summit have supported the move."
Nasdaq futures (.NQc1) rose 0.1% while European futures were 0.24% higher.
China's blue-chip stock index (.CSI300) rose 0.18%, while Hong Kong's Hang Seng index (.HSI) gained 0.3%. AI stocks in China (.CSI930713) and Hong Kong (.HSAIT) also surged.
TRUMP-XI MEETING AWAITED Attention is turning to a high-stakes meeting between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping later this week, with investors watching for any indications that the leaders of the world's two largest economies can prevent a further deterioration in relations.
Xi arrives in Washington on Wednesday for the first time in more than a decade amid growing optimism that a trade truce deal between the two nations will be extended and there could be potential cooperation over artificial intelligence.
William Bratton, head of cash equity research for APAC at BNP Paribas, expects this state visit to be similar to Trump's visit to China in May.
"Lots of positive optics and words but not much to materially change underlying trajectories. In fact, we are more concerned by what happens after the state visit and not what happens during it," he said.
Brent crude futures steadied at $100.65 per barrel after dropping over 3% in the previous session, moving below the key $100 level briefly.
President Trump said he would be open to meeting Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, who is expected to be in New York this week for the UN General Assembly, helping lift sentiment and pushing bond yields lower.
"The drop in oil is a big factor," said Nick Twidale, chief market strategist at ATFX Global. "Oil is the main driver and investors are jumping back into AI as has been the pattern this year."
RATE HIKES ON THE WAY Investors are also contending with a fresh wave of rate hikes and hawkish signals from major central banks, reinforcing expectations of further tightening later this year. The shift has underpinned the dollar and piled pressure on the yen.
The yen was at 157.47 per US dollar, hovering near a three-week low after surrendering early-month gains driven by bets on a faster pace of Bank of Japan rate hikes.
The BOJ raised rates last week to a 31-year high but two dissenting votes and lack of explicit hawkish guidance disappointed investors, leaving the yen vulnerable and stoking intervention jitters.
"FX intervention remains a blunt tool to prop up currencies, and without a forceful monetary policy response it will be difficult for Japanese authorities to rein in the selloff in the yen," said Matthew Ryan, head of market strategy at Ebury.
The Federal Reserve, by contrast, raised rates last week and warned its fight against inflation was not over, keeping the door open to further tightening.
The dollar index , which measures the US currency against six other units, was at 100.4, just shy of a seven-week high. Traders are pricing in a 56% chance of a hike in October, compared with 43.5% a week earlier, CME FedWatch tool showed.

Sept 21 : US federal prosecutors are investigating whether Binance violated sanctions on Iran by failing to prevent certain trading activity on its platform, Bloomberg News reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the matter.
Here are a few details:
• The probe is being led by the Manhattan US attorney's office, with the Justice Department's criminal division in Washington also involved, Bloomberg News reported, adding that authorities are examining whether Binance knowingly allowed the trading.
• Binance said in a statement that it has a zero-tolerance approach to sanctions violations. "We fully cooperate with law enforcement, and we remain committed to rooting out and shutting down bad actors."

• The DOJ declined to comment, while the Manhattan US attorney's office could not immediately be reached for a comment outside regular business hours.
• Binance has faced US scrutiny in the past. In 2023, Binance's then-chief Changpeng Zhao stepped down and pleaded guilty to breaking US anti-money laundering laws as part of a $4.3 billion settlement resolving a years-long probe into the world's largest crypto exchange.
• The US government earlier this month imposed sanctions on firms and individuals it says are helping Hezbollah and other Iranian proxies in the Middle East, intensifying its campaign to isolate Iran economically.

items.title: AI関連株が急伸、メタのパーソナルAIエージェントで楽観論
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 22日の株式市場では、世界のAI関連株が上昇している。台湾株は日中最高値を更新した。米メタ・プラットフォームズの新たなパーソナルAIエージェントに初期段階で成功の兆しが見られたことで、半導体需要への楽観的な見方が再燃した。

韓国の半導体メーカー、サムスン電子とSKハイニックスの株価は取引序盤に一時約3.5%上昇し、台湾加権指数は1.9%高となった。21日の米国市場では、フィラデルフィア半導体株指数（SOX）が4.3%高で取引を終え、単日として8月4日以来の大幅上昇率を記録。メタ株は11%の急伸となった。

今回の上昇は、メタのAIエージェント「Muse（ミューズ）」が今月の提供開始から間もなく、アップルの無料アプリランキングで首位に浮上したことを受けたものだ。好調な滑り出しにより、割高なバリュエーションへの懸念から7月に急落したAI関連株への信頼が回復しつつある。最近では、高度なAIモデルがもたらす存亡に関わる脅威についてテクノロジー業界幹部が警告したことで、新たな相場変動にも見舞われていた。

ペッパーストーンのストラテジスト、ディリン・ウー氏は「市場は、これが単なる製品の成功事例ではなく、AI向けコンピューティング需要の構造的な見通しを見直す動きだと素早く理解した」と指摘。Museが広く普及すれば、AIインフラのサプライチェーン全体で需要が大幅に押し上げられ、半導体メーカーがこの流れの主要な恩恵を受ける可能性があると話した。

Museは「WhatsApp（ワッツアップ）」などメタのアプリ全体のデータを活用し、第三者のサービスと連携して、ユーザーに代わってタスクを実行できるパーソナルAIエージェントだ。投資家は、Museが汎用（はんよう）アシスタントのMeta AIよりも多くのコンピューティング能力を必要とするとみており、サプライチェーン全体の需要を押し上げると期待している。

SEOUL, Sept 22 : A board member of the Bank of Korea said on Tuesday the central bank will determine the timing and pace of further interest rate hikes by closely assessing inflation, economic growth and financial stability.
• "Going forward, factors such as accumulating financial imbalances, sector-specific income improvements, global market trends and geopolitical risks will likely shape financial stability," Chang Yong-sung said in remarks released with the central bank's financial stability report.
• To prevent financial imbalances from deepening, Chang stressed the need to operate monetary and macroprudential policies in a complementary manner, while seeking policy coordination with fiscal and financial authorities to micro-manage difficulties faced by vulnerable groups.
• The BOK on August 27 raised its benchmark interest rate by a quarter percentage point to 3.00 per cent, delivering a second straight increase as inflation remained above target and financial stability risks persisted.

Source: Reuters

items.title: 韓国大統領、米に北朝鮮制裁の緩和要請　核開発凍結へ＝米紙
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ソウル ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソウル ２２日 ロイター] - 韓国の李在明大統領は、北朝鮮が核兵器開発凍結で合意するのと引き換えに、米国に対北朝鮮制裁を緩和するよう求めた。米紙ニューヨーク・タイムズ（ＮＹＴ）が報じた。

同紙によると、李氏はインタビューで「そもそもさほど効果的ではない制裁と、さらなる核兵器や大陸間弾道ミサイル（ＩＣＢＭ）技術の開発停止とのトレードオフには大きな価値があると考える」と述べた。

また、現状の下で非核化を追求しても何も達成できないとし、核兵器開発の凍結を確保できれば、相互の見返りや譲歩を通じて信頼を醸成し、最終的に北朝鮮に核兵器を削減するよう説得することが可能になるとの考えを示した。

現在の膠着状態を続けるのはあまりにリスクが大きいとし、北朝鮮は現在、毎年１０─２０発の核兵器を追加で製造する能力があり、既に製造している可能性もあるとの韓国の分析に言及した。

「北朝鮮は体制存続を保証するのに十分な核兵器とミサイルを蓄積したと判断すれば、資金稼ぎのために輸出しようとする誘惑に駆られるだろう。それは実に危険な瞬間になる」と警鐘を鳴らした。

韓国政府当局者はこれまで、北朝鮮対応で「非核化優先」の政策から「平和優先」のアプローチへとかじを切りつつあると説明してきた。李氏は２０２５年、北朝鮮の体制を尊重し、平和共存を目指すと表明した。

ただ、南北関係は依然として冷え込んだままだ。北朝鮮の金正恩朝鮮労働党総書記は南北統一を放棄し、韓国を最も敵対的な国家と位置付け、前線防衛の強化を命じている。

トランプ米大統領は金氏との新たな会談を模索しており、李氏も対話実現を支持する立場を示している。

李氏は今週、国連総会に合わせて朝鮮半島の平和と共存に向けた構想を打ち出す方針。

items.title: シルバーウィークの日経平均先物急伸、「Muse」人気で米テック株高騰
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 大型連休（シルバーウイーク）中の22日の日本市場では、祝日取引が行われている株式先物が急伸した。米メタ・プラットフォームズの新しいAIエージェントが好調な滑り出しとなり、前日の米国株市場でテクノロジー株が高騰したことでAI関連企業の業績の先行きに楽観的な見方が広がった格好だ。

大阪取引所の日経平均先物12月限は、一時前営業日比2.9%高の6万6980円まで上げ幅を拡大した。午前11時時点では6万6600円台で推移。

メタの新AIエージェント「Muse（ミューズ）」が米国のモバイルアプリランキングで首位となり、競争が激しさを増す消費者向けAIアシスタント市場で同社が存在感を高めていることを示した。

これを受け、21日の米国株市場ではAIを支える半導体株が急伸。10%高と大きく上げたアドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（AMD）の時価総額は、初めて1兆ドル（約157兆4000億円）を突破した。インテルなども買われ、フィラデルフィア半導体株指数（SOX）は4.3%高で5営業日続伸となった。

キャピタル・ドット・コムのシニアアナリスト、カイル・ロッダ氏はメタがリリースした新AIチャットボットが強い需要を集めており、AI関連銘柄の成長見通しに対する楽観的な見方が再び高まっていると指摘。AI需要の堅調は「AIエコシステム、特に半導体分野の市場心理を改善させ、影響はアジアのハイテクセクターの一部にも波及するだろう」と述べた。

日経平均先物以外にも22日のアジア株式市場ではテック株の影響を受けやすい韓国総合株価指数（KOSPI）が一時2.3%高まで買われ、台湾の加権指数は一時1.8%高と日中ベースの最高値を更新した。

この他、米国とイランの戦争終結に向けた外交努力への期待で、国際原油市況が下落したことも金利高への不安を後退させた点で投資家心理にプラスに働いている。21日の北海ブレント先物は4営業日続落し、1バレル＝100ドル付近で終了した。

By David Brunnstrom and Joe Cash
Sept 21 (Reuters) – U.S. President Donald Trump will welcome Chinese leader Xi Jinping this week for their second meeting this year, as the two leaders seek stability in a relationship under pressure over issues ranging from trade to Taiwan and Iran, as well as global worries about artificial intelligence.

Xi arrives in Washington on Wednesday for the first time in more than a decade. In the four months since the leaders of the two superpowers met in Beijing in May, Xi has overseen a surge in China’s trade with the world, while Trump — mired in the Iran war and with low approval ratings — is looking for economic wins he can tout to Americans unhappy with rising prices.

Here are some of the key issues for their summit at the White House on Thursday:

Show Full Article

TRADE TRUCE OR BACK TO TRADE WAR?

Markets will watch for signs of an extension of a tariff truce announced after a Trump-Xi summit in South Korea last October and set to expire on November 10. That deal paused a trade war in which the world’s two largest economies threatened global supply chains with tit-for-tat tariffs that topped 100%.

U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said this month the countries will make “some announcements on agriculture and non-tariff barriers” and traders will be watching for progress on an agreed mutual tariff reduction covering $30 billion in goods — a step China could most easily take by cutting duties on U.S. agricultural imports.

JETS, FARM PRODUCE

Trump will be looking to announce trade wins ahead of November midterm congressional elections, including by locking in high-profile purchases of Boeing aircraft and agricultural products.  

Greer said on Monday China is making progress on a commitment to buy 200 Boeings but gave no indication that any additional orders are near.

Trump said in May that China could potentially boost its Boeing order, the manufacturer’s first major Chinese deal in nearly a decade, to as many as 750 planes.

However, Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg last week played down some expectations among industry analysts that China could make another Boeing order around the Trump-Xi talks.

“I think there’ll be an increment of orders going forward,” he told an investor conference. “They’re going to be announced by the airlines at their pace, however they want to announce those.”

Industry sources say a larger deal has been stalled for years as Trump has threatened to cut off China’s access to critical spare engine parts.

The White House said after the May summit that China had committed to purchasing at least $17 billion per year of US agricultural products in 2026, 2027 and 2028.

US Senator Pete Ricketts, Republican chair of the Senate Foreign Relations subcommittee on East Asia, said last week Trump should press Xi to honor those commitments and follow through on pledges to open its market to more US beef exports.

CHINA GRIP ON RARE EARTHS

Beijing has been pressing the US to further delay a rule that would bar thousands of Chinese firms from receiving advanced US technology, while Washington wants Beijing to ease shipments of rare earths and critical minerals vital for high-tech applications spanning automobile to aerospace manufacturing, as well as defense.

Experts say Trump has taken a less combative approach than usual ahead of his meeting with Xi because of China’s growing power thanks to critical minerals. China controls up to 70% of global rare-earth mining, 85% of refining capacity, and about 90% of rare-earth metal alloy and magnet production, according to consultancy AlixPartners.

The Trump administration has so far not threatened to slap steep tariffs on Chinese imports or to ban exports of US technology, in contrast to the aggressive stances that preceded previous summits. Last year, in retaliation against Trump’s tariffs, China curbed rare earth exports and sent shockwaves through world markets.

TAIWAN

US allies in Asia have grown increasingly concerned that in order to lock in economic wins, Trump may be tempted to soften Washington’s support for Taiwan, the democratically governed island claimed by China.

Taiwan strongly objects to the sovereignty claims.

While the US, like most countries, has no formal diplomatic relations with Taiwan, it is its most important international backer and arms supplier.

Trump said Xi pressed him on US arms sales to Taiwan during the May visit, with the US president later describing a pending package worth up to $14 billion as a “negotiating chip”.

As well as arms, people familiar with Chinese efforts told Reuters that Beijing also hopes to persuade Trump to state publicly that the US opposes Taiwan’s independence instead of saying only that it does not support independence, which has been Washington’s formulation for decades.

Any US shift on Taiwan would be highly controversial, raising questions about Washington’s resolve to defend the island and provoking opposition in Congress.

On Monday, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio met with his counterparts from Japan and South Korea and reiterated the US commitment to the defense of those key Asian allies, and the three nations expressed support for Taiwan.

In a letter to Trump on Friday, John Moolenaar, Republican chairman of the House Select Committee on China, wrote in a reference to Taiwan and US allies in Asia that Chinese objections to US arms sales and security cooperation should be “rejected out of hand.”

IRAN WAR

China maintains close ties to Tehran and is by far the world’s biggest buyer of Iranian oil exports. Washington sees Xi as uniquely able to exert pressure on Tehran, but he has shown little inclination to do so.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has said Trump and Xi would continue discussions on China’s financial ties to Tehran during the summit. But despite US frustration with Beijing, Bessent stopped short of imposing penalties on Chinese banks when he unveiled an “economic onslaught” against Iran last month and warned countries to cut business ties with the country.

Last week, Trump brushed aside a report that Iran acquired satellite images of a base in Jordan from Chinese entities before an attack that killed three US troops there in July.

Reuters reported last month that Beijing is selling billions of dollars’ worth of goods to Iran through a sanctions-evasion scheme. China’s foreign ministry says it is not aware of this.

ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE

Analysts see artificial intelligence as a potential area for cooperation, given its implications for national security, economic competitiveness and military capabilities, and shared US and Chinese concerns about misuse. However, experts say intense competition in the field between the countries is likely to limit the scope for anything beyond symbolic agreements.

Bessent said after talks with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng at the weekend that the two sides discussed setting up a new US-China AI dialogue. This would include a notification system for common goals and common threats that would cover AI-related incidents that rise to a national security level.

Dario Amodei, chief executive of US AI firm Anthropic, warned this month that Chinese dominance in AI could pose security risks to the United States.  

Chinese state media dismissed this warning as coming from a “Cold War playbook,” while Trump has brushed aside calls to slow AI development, saying that “very negative forces” were raising exaggerated concerns.

(Reporting by David Brunnstrom and David Shepardson in Washington, David Lawder and Antoni Slodkowski in New York and Joe Cash in Beijing; Editing by Kevin Buckland)

items.title: La Fed recupera credibilidad, pero incertidumbre sobre inflación y tasas aún pesa en los mercados
items.author: Michael Msika
items.summary: La Fed logró recuperar credibilidad al demostrar que no se está quedando rezagada frente a la inflación, con un mensaje de tono restrictivo, aunque sin dar señales de que se avecine un ciclo agresivo ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Una mayor claridad sobre la determinación de la Reserva Federal para combatir la inflación está dando a los inversionistas razones para mostrarse optimistas, pero los riesgos asociados con los precios del petróleo y la inteligencia artificial les impiden comprometerse por completo. Ver más: 70 años de alzas de tasas de la Fed: ¿qué enseñan los ciclos pasados a la economía actual? La Reserva Federal logró la semana pasada recuperar credibilidad al demostrar que no se está quedando rezagada frente a la inflación, con un mensaje de tono restrictivo, aunque sin dar señales de que se avecine un ciclo agresivo de alzas de tasas. Aunque esto fue suficiente inicialmente para tranquilizar a los mercados, el nerviosismo siguió presente el viernes, cuando el rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro de EE.UU. a 10 años volvió a acercarse al 5% y el S&P 500 fluctuó entre ganancias y pérdidas. “Es difícil prever una estabilización total de las tasas de interés y las acciones hasta que disminuyan las presiones inflacionarias relacionadas con el sector energético”, afirmaron los estrategas de Barclays Plc, liderados por Emmanuel Cau. “No obstante, el aspecto positivo es que se ha reafirmado la independencia y la credibilidad de la Reserva Federal, lo que aporta claridad sobre su función de reacción”. La decisión de la Fed puede considerarse un acontecimiento de ajuste. El giro hacia la cautela de los inversores de cara a la reunión sobre política monetaria demostró que estaban lejos de mostrarse complacientes, con claros indicios de que habían reducido su exposición al tiempo que aumentaban las coberturas. El masivo vencimiento trimestral del viernes también contribuyó en gran medida a reajustar las posiciones en opciones. Ver más: BofA advierte que la Fed podría llevar las tasas de interés por encima del 5% “Con un sólido crecimiento de los beneficios, unos diferenciales de crédito contenidos y un VIX moderado, los fundamentos de la renta variable estadounidense siguen siendo favorables, lo que nos lleva a mantener una visión constructiva sobre el S&P 500 más allá de la volatilidad a corto plazo”, afirmó Manish Kabra, estratega de Société Générale SA. La curva de tasas sigue siendo una señal clave y, siempre que se evite la inversión, Kabra espera que el índice de referencia alcance los 8.000 puntos a finales de año, a pesar de cierta volatilidad. Si bien la posibilidad de un repunte a fin de año sigue latente, lograrlo podría no ser fácil. Los precios del diésel apuntan a una mayor inflación en el futuro, y a menos que la guerra en Irán se resuelva con la suficiente rapidez como para reducir significativamente los precios del petróleo, el banco central podría verse obligado a adoptar una postura aún más restrictiva. Según el mercado de swaps, ya se han descontado otras tres alzas de tasas para finales de julio. Todas las miradas estarán puestas en una posible sacudida en el mercado de bonos, ya que los rendimientos a 10 años por encima del 5% hacen que los bonos del Tesoro resulten cada vez más atractivos. No obstante, mientras el crecimiento económico y de los beneficios se mantenga sólido, es posible que los inversores se muestren reacios a abandonar la renta variable y prefieran seguir ampliando su exposición. Ver más: Cuatro razones por las que el mercado puede subestimar el alza de tasas de la Fed Los estrategas de Bank of America Corp. ( BAC ), liderados por Jared Woodard, se han vuelto más cautelosos y afirman que el posicionamiento sigue siendo demasiado alcista, dada la moderación prevista en los beneficios para el próximo año. Señalaron que el crecimiento del 10%-15% previsto para 2027 implica un índice ISM manufacturero por encima de 53 durante un período prolongado. “Aún no es el momento de apostar por los valores defensivos, pero la calidad, el valor y el rendimiento parecen opciones prudentes”, afirmaron. El mercado se ha vuelto más escéptico respecto al gasto en inteligencia artificial y a la rentabilidad futura de dichas inversiones. Esto ha sembrado algunas dudas sobre las perspectivas de beneficios para toda la cadena de beneficiarios de la inteligencia artificial. Mientras tanto, se ha producido una rotación dentro del sector tecnológico: el software ha vuelto con más fuerza, mientras que los semiconductores se han estancado en gran medida en los últimos dos meses y se han vuelto cada vez más volátiles. Las valoraciones han descendido bruscamente en el S&P 500 y el índice de referencia cotiza ahora justo por encima de su media a largo plazo. Si bien la revisión a la baja de las valoraciones tiene más que ver con el aumento de las estimaciones de beneficios, el reciente retroceso demuestra que los inversores no están dispuestos a pagar un sobreprecio por el crecimiento, ya sea a nivel del índice o del sector. Si la cautela se mantiene a corto plazo, una temporada de resultados que supere las expectativas dentro de unas semanas podría reactivar la confianza y la disposición a asumir riesgos. Ver más: Precio del dólar, oro, bonos y acciones: qué cambia tras incremento en la tasas de la Fed “La resiliencia de los inversores sugiere que están distinguiendo entre las tasas de interés más altas provocadas por una inflación persistente y un panorama de crecimiento que se deteriora fundamentalmente”, afirmó Daniela Hathorn, analista sénior de mercado de Capital.com. “Por ahora, esto último no se ha convertido en la principal preocupación”. items.title: 紅海での船舶保護任務、軍艦10隻超必要＝ＥＵ外相
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
John Irish

[ニューヨーク ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
John Irish

[ニューヨーク ２１日 ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）のカラス外交安全保障上級代表（外相に相当）は２１日、紅海で船舶保護を担うＥＵ海軍任務について、軍艦を１０隻超に増やす必要があるという認識を示した。現状は同海域にそれだけの艦艇が配備されていないと指摘した。 

ＥＵの海軍任務「アスピデス」は、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派による攻撃から船舶を保護するため２０２４年に始動した。外交筋によると、現在６隻の軍艦が活動している。

カラス氏は国連総会のハイレベル会合の合間に記者団に対し、「アスピデスが設置された際、少なくとも１０隻が必要だとの指摘があった。現在の状況はさらに深刻だと思う」と語った。

フーシ派はここ数週間、紅海沿岸で急速に勢力を拡大しており、米国とイランの戦争によって既に船舶の往来が減少しているホルムズ海峡を含むこの地域の航路をさらに複雑にしている。

アスピデス任務の中核国の一つであるイタリアは１７日、自国船向けに同地域で海軍任務を準備していると発表し、新たな危機へのＥＵの対応を待つことはできないと表明した。

カラス氏は、フーシ派の攻撃が欧州の利益に影響を及ぼし、世界経済に打撃を与えていると指摘。

「ＥＵの作戦アスピデスは、地域の安全保障と世界の海運に極めて重要な貢献をしているが、地域における脅威の高まりに対処するためには、より多くの海上・航空装備が必要だ」と語った。

items.title: China's Ligent jumps 19% in Hong Kong debut as AI demand draws investors
items.author: Yantoultra Ngui, Donny Kwok
items.creator: Yantoultra Ngui, Donny Kwok
items.summary: Shares of Chinese fibre-optic communications equipment maker Ligent Technologies jumped as much as 19.2% in their Hong Kong debut on Tuesday, after the company tapped demand for AI-related equipment to raise HK$5.67 billion ($723 million).
items.body:
Shares of Chinese fibre-optic communications equipment maker Ligent Technologies (9856.HK) jumped as much as 19.2% in their Hong Kong debut on Tuesday, after the company tapped demand for AI-related equipment to raise HK$5.67 billion ($723 million).
The stock hit a high of HK$39.3 a share and last traded at HK$35.90, up 8.9%. Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index (.HSI) was up 0.3%, while the Hang Seng Tech Index (.HSTECH) climbed 0.6%.
Ligent makes optical transceivers, chips and network terminals. Its transceivers are devices that convert data into light signals so they can travel quickly through fibre-optic cables.
The company's listing comes as investors seek exposure to [USN:L1N45902I TEXT:"suppliers"] of equipment used in artificial intelligence data centres, which need faster links between servers and switches.
"The company's vertical integration in the optical module manufacturing is a decent selling point despite the fact that its current shipment is still skewed towards the lower end of the optical module product spectrum," said Ke Yan, head of research at Singapore-based investment research firm Shenton Research.
"The key risk is that the valuation for players in the AI supply chain have built in exponential compute-demand driven growth. Therefore, deceleration of such growth in the demand will become catalyst for de-rating of such players," he added.
Ligent [USN:L1N455080 TEXT:"sold"] 172.01 million shares in its base offering, giving it a market value of about HK$32.4 billion at the offer price, according to its listing prospectus.
Cornerstone investors include Primavera Investment Fund, GigaDevice, Amlogic Hong Kong, Mirae Asset Securities HK, PAG, ORIX-backed Turquoise Hime, Barings, GF Fund and E Fund, the prospectus showed.
The public offering was subscribed 35.16 times, while the international offering was subscribed 4.67 times, according to a [USN:FWN45D0JQ TEXT:"filing"] on Monday.
The company said it plans to spend about 52.9% of the net proceeds on research and development, mainly for faster optical products and chips. It will use about 25.1% to expand production capacity.
Ligent posted a 29.7% increase in net profit to 661 million yuan ($98.7 million) for the six months ended June 30 versus the same period a year earlier, and a 27.9% increase in revenue at 5.39 billion yuan.
Hisense Group Holding will retain control of about 40.1% of Ligent after the offering, assuming no overallotment option is exercised.
($1 = 7.8456 Hong Kong dollars)
($1 = 6.6968 Chinese yuan renminbi)

items.title: ＭＬＢ＝崖っぷちのブルージェイズ、ゲレロが腰の張りでスタメン外れる
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）でポストシーズン進出を争うブルージェイズの主力打者、ブラディミール・ゲレロ内野手が、２１日のオリオールズ戦で先発メンバーから外れた。ＭＬＢ公式サイトが報じた。

ゲレロは２０日のレンジャーズ戦で、左腰の張りを訴えて途中交代していた。ジョン・シュナイダー監督は復帰時期について「本人の調子が良くなり、スイング時に大きな違和感がなければ。本当に日々の状態次第だ」と語った。

今季のゲレロはシーズンを通じて腰のトラブルを抱えている。シュナイダー監督は「特に、足を踏み込んで回転する動作の時に影響が出ている。昨日のいくつかのスイングでも、それが見て取れた。試合前から少し張りがあることは分かっていたが、いつものようなスイングができていなかった」と述べている。

ゲレロは２０２１年に４８本塁打を放ってタイトルを獲得。しかし状態が整わない今季は、１４１試合の出場で打率２割６分３厘、９本塁打、５６打点と低迷している。

ブルージェイズは２０日時点で７７勝７９敗。ワイルドカード争いではポストシーズン圏内の３位ホワイトソックスから３ゲーム差で、残り６試合での逆転に向けて厳しい状況に置かれている。

items.title: ＭＬＢ＝ファウルボール顔面直撃のブレグマンは複数骨折、ＰＳで復帰も
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）の試合中にファウルボールが顔面に直撃したカブスのアレックス・ブレグマン内野手が複数の骨折を負ったことが判明。ただし手術は行わず、ポストシーズンで復帰する可能性は残されているという。米ＥＳＰＮが報じた。

ブレグマンは２０日のレッズ戦でネクストバッターズサークルにいた際、味方打者のファウルボールが顔面に直撃。顔から出血したブレグマンはトレーナーに付き添われてクラブハウスへと下がった。

病院でＸ線検査とＣＴスキャンを受けたブレグマンは、交流サイトに目が腫れた状態の写真を投稿し、「みんな、メッセージをありがとう。必ず戻ってくる」とのメッセージを添えた。

ブレグマンはカブス移籍１年目の今季、１５３試合に出場して打率２割６分２厘、２６本塁打、８９打点をマーク。主力打者としてプレーオフ進出を争うカブスを支えていた。

US stresses backing for Japan, Korea and Taiwan ahead of Trump-Xi summit

Republic of Korea's Foreign Minister Cho Hyun (left) and Japanese Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi meet with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on the sidelines of the 81st United Nations General Assembly in New York City on Sep 21, 2026. (Photo: Pool via AFP)

NEW YORK: The United States on Monday (Sep 21) reiterated its commitment to the defence of key Asian allies Japan and South Korea, and the three nations expressed support for Taiwan ahead of a summit this week between US President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping.
Analysts say the US allies are anxious that Trump may offer concessions to Xi, including over Taiwan and trade, in return for an economic win with Beijing when he hosts Xi at the White House in Washington on Thursday.
Officials say both Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi and South Korean President Lee Jae Myung are keen to see the US president during the UN General Assembly in New York, where all three are scheduled to speak on Tuesday.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio met with his South Korean counterpart Cho Hyun and Japan's Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi in New York on Monday.

They issued a joint statement vowing, in apparent reference to China, to stand firm "against economic coercion and non-market policies and practices" and "arbitrary export restrictions that disrupt supply chains".
They also welcomed the launch of a new trilateral consultation mechanism on economic security, part of broader efforts to strengthen supply chains and cooperation on critical technologies.
The statement said the US "reiterated its ironclad commitments to the defence of Japan and the ROK, backed by America’s unmatched military strength, including its nuclear capabilities, and reaffirmed its extended deterrence commitments to Japan and the ROK", using the initials for the Republic of Korea, South Korea's official name.
The statement said the ministers emphasised their commitment to robust security cooperation and the importance of maintaining peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait. 
It also "expressed support for Taiwan’s meaningful participation in appropriate international organisations".
Taiwan's government welcomed the comments.
In a statement, its foreign ministry said the renewed joint public support for maintaining peace and stability shows that security in the strait has become a "strong consensus of the international community".
Referring to North Korea, the ministers "reaffirmed their resolute commitment to the complete denuclearisation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea" and called on it to resume dialogue.
In addition to concerns about Taiwan, a democratically governed island China claims as its own, analysts said allies will be scrutinising any trade announcements from the Trump-Xi summit for their impact on competitiveness relative to China. Even a modest reduction in trade barriers for Beijing could erode their positions.
Takaichi angered Beijing last year by saying Tokyo could be drawn into a conflict over Taiwan, and Seoul and Washington have been negotiating details of South Korea's US$350 billion investment package in the US under a trade deal struck by the allies last year.
On Monday, a South Korean opposition lawmaker called for parliamentary scrutiny of the investment package, warning that negotiations over energy projects could leave South Korea carrying disproportionate financial risks.

items.title: Tigers ride 3 home runs to blowout win over Nationals
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Ben Malgeri hit a three-run homer and the host Detroit Tigers opened a three-game series with a 9-2 romp over the Washington Nationals on Monday night.
items.body:
Ben Malgeri hit a three-run homer and the host Detroit Tigers opened a three-game series with a 9-2 romp over the Washington Nationals on Monday night.
Javier Baez and Spencer Torkelson each supplied two-run shots for the Tigers (74-83), who were officially eliminated from playoff contention on Sunday with a loss to the Chicago White Sox.
Detroit's Hao-Yu Lee contributed three hits, a run and an RBI, Eduardo Valencia had three hits and a run and Dillon Dingler added two hits and two runs as the Tigers won for just the second time in six games.
River Ryan started for Detroit and pitched three scoreless innings while recording three strikeouts in his Tigers debut. He yielded two hits and walked one.
Ryan, elevated from Triple-A Toledo, was one of three prospects acquired from the Los Angeles Dodgers in the blockbuster Tarik Skubal trade last month. Ryan pitched four games with the Dodgers in 2024 before undergoing Tommy John surgery.
Tigers right-hander Keider Montero (10-9) threw four shutout innings while striking out five. He permitted one hit and one walk.
Washington starter DJ Herz (0-1), like Ryan, made his first major league appearance since the 2024 season. He gave up four runs on five hits in four innings with four strikeouts and two walks.
Pinch hitter Yohandy Morales produced a two-run homer for the Nationals (73-84), who took their second loss in a row.
Detroit jumped to a 2-0 lead in the first. Herz walked Gleyber Torres on four pitches and threw a wild pitch with Lee batting, moving Torres to second. Lee then smacked an RBI ground-rule double. Lee moved to third on a one-out Valencia single and scored on an error by left fielder James Wood.
The lead grew to 4-0 in the fourth. Dingler walked to open the frame, and one out later, Baez pulled a Herz changeup over the left field wall.
Detroit made it 9-0 in the fifth. Riley Greene drew a one-out walk and moved to third on a Valencia double. Malgeri then knocked a splitter over the left field wall.
Dingler followed with a double before Torkelson clubbed a fastball out to left.
Morales' homer came in the eighth off Drew Sommers with two outs and Wood, who had singled, on first base.
--Field Level Media

items.title: 米テキサス州、データセンター新規許可を停止　電力網監査完了まで
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Liz Hampton　Laila Kearney

[デンバー／ニューヨーク ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Liz Hampton　Laila Kearney

[デンバー／ニューヨーク ２１日 ロイター] - 米テキサス州のアボット知事（共和党）は２１日、州の環境当局に対し、データセンター向けの新規許可発行を停止するよう命じた。同州の電力網への接続を求めているデータセンターに対する大規模な監査を規制当局が完了するまで停止する。

テキサス州環境品質委員会（ＴＣＥＱ）に対する知事の指示により、データセンター開発業者向けに州が発行する許可は事実上、全て凍結される。同州にはこれまで、豊富な電力と広大な土地、ビジネスに友好的な環境を求めて開発業者が殺到していた。

約３年前に人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームが始まって以降、テキサス州は世界で最も急成長しているデータセンター集積地の一つとなった。しかし、施設に対する世論の反発が強まり、ＡＩ全般に対する懸念も高まったことから、アボット知事は先月、新規データセンターの州電力網への接続を凍結し、施設の監査を命じた。

テキサス州の電力網運営機関ＥＲＣＯＴは、データセンターの電力使用量や税制優遇措置、水消費量などの監査を開始した段階にある。

アボット氏は声明で、「端的に言えば、テキサス州民が最優先されなければならない。データセンターは自らの費用を負担し、われわれの電力網と水を守り、（監査を）完了しなければならない」と述べた。

items.title: 米中、首脳会議を前にAIや投資を議論－NYでの2日目の協議終える
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国と中国の当局者は21日、ニューヨークで2日目の協議を終えた。今週予定されている習近平国家主席の訪米を前に交渉を進展させることを目指し、AIや投資、貿易について協議した。

中国財政省の廖岷次官は、協議が行われたニューヨークのJPモルガン・チェース本社前で短く発言し、21日の話し合いでは米中双方の首席交渉官が合意した内容の履行にフォーカスしたと述べた。貿易休戦の延長を巡る協議について質問されたのに対し、廖氏はコメントしなかった。会場では、両国の他の高官の姿は確認されなかった。

ベッセント米財務長官、中国の何立峰副首相、李成鋼商務次官（国際貿易交渉代表）らは、20日に終日協議した。

李氏は20日の協議後、「良い雰囲気」で議論が行われたと述べ、ベッセント氏は「非常に成功した」と評価した。ベッセント氏は、米中両国がAI技術の恩恵と脅威について共通認識を形成することを目的とする「米中AI対話」と呼ぶ枠組みを設けることで合意したと話した。

貿易休戦が11月に期限を迎える中、焦点は米中が延長で合意できるか、合意した場合にどの程度の期間となるかだ。グリア米通商代表部（USTR）代表は21日、ブルームバーグテレビジョンとのインタビューで3－6カ月の延長は可能だと述べ、条件を協議する時間はまだあると語った。

トランプ米大統領と習氏は、貿易、レアアース（希土類）、AIなどの問題について協議すると予想されている。中国の税関統計によると、8月の中国から米国へのレアアース磁石の輸出は前月比21%減の512トンとなった。昨年の貿易休戦にもかかわらず、中国が重要鉱物の供給を引き続き絞っているとの懸念を浮き彫りにしている。

原題：China, US Discuss AI, Investment on Second Day of Trade Talks（抜粋）

items.title: 豪中銀、追加利上げ必要も　インフレ定着を懸念＝ハンター総裁補
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [シドニー ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[シドニー ２２日 ロイター] - オーストラリア準備銀行（中央銀行）のハンター総裁補は２２日、インフレを確実に抑え込むため、今年４回目となる利上げが必要になる可能性があるとの見解を改めて示した。市場では早ければ来週にも利上げが実施されるとの観測が強まっている。

ハンター氏はポッドキャスト番組で、中銀はインフレが長期間にわたり高止まりしており、価格設定行動に定着するリスクがあると懸念していると述べた。

「インフレ率が現在の想定よりもやや高くなる可能性を示す要因は数多く見られる」と述べ、中東紛争によるエネルギーコストの上昇や、国内需要が供給を上回っている兆候を挙げた。

その上で「こうした圧力に真に対処するため、景気をもう少し減速させるよう政策金利を再び引き上げなければならないと考える可能性もある」と述べた。

豪中銀は今年２月以降、計７５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを実施し、政策金利はコロナ禍後最高の４．３５％に達した。それでもコアインフレ率は依然として３．６％で推移しており、中銀の目標レンジ（２─３％）を大幅に上回っている。

市場は２９日の会合で政策金利が４．６０％に引き上げられる確率を９５％織り込み、金利は来年初めまでに４．８５％でピークに達すると予想している。

ハンター氏は「インフレは和らいでいくと期待しているが、そのためにはいくつかの要因が想定通りに展開するのを待ち、見極める必要がある」とし、「今後数カ月の推移を見守ることになる」と語った。

By Brad Brooks and Kanishka Singh
Sept 21 (Reuters) – A man identified as the Venezuelan who was shot and wounded by a federal immigration agent in Texas said on Monday that he was in pain and being held at an ICE detention center with a bullet lodged in his back.

Attorney Kate Lincoln-Goldfinch introduced the man who phoned into a news conference she was holding in Austin as her client, Wilber Rafael Garces Perez. He said he was bleeding and was not receiving adequate medical care in a Texas detention facility. 

“I’m not doing well because of the gunshot I received,” Perez, 28, said in Spanish as reporters listened to a speakerphone, adding that he had to sleep on the floor at the detention center.

Show Full Article

Attorney Lincoln-Goldfinch said at the news conference that Perez was being held at the South Texas ICE Processing Center, about 130 miles southwest of Austin, and that he was undergoing questioning by agents. 

Perez said he was released within four hours of arriving at a hospital, and that a doctor treating him told him ICE agents were in a hurry to transfer him to a detention center. 

He said that he had been out working as a DoorDash food delivery driver on Sunday when his car was sideswiped by the agents, who he said did not identify themselves or turn on any sort of lights or siren. He said that an agent shot him while he was still in his car and that there had been no foot chase. Austin police said on Sunday that he had run from agents.

Neither ICE nor the Department of Homeland Security, which oversees ICE, responded to requests for comment on Monday. 

DHS on Sunday released a written statement saying that Perez was in the US illegally and that he had a final order of removal from the country. They did not provide details on the circumstance of the shooting.  

The New York Times, citing two unnamed people it said were familiar with the federal investigation into the shooting, reported on Monday that ICE agents were out in Austin checking license plates when they discovered that Perez had a deportation order. The agents, the newspaper reported, pulled Perez over around 12:45 p.m. (1745 GMT) identified themselves and said he was going to be arrested, at which point Perez allegedly fled in his car, leading to a short chase, sideswiping and shooting. 

Lincoln-Goldfinch, speaking on CNN, said that account of the events “doesn’t match” what Perez told her, though she provided no details on if he had been stopped by ICE agents before being shot. 

Federal immigration officials have been involved in multiple shootings this year, including the killing of two US citizens in Minnesota, which sparked a widespread backlash. More than 50 people have died in ICE detention since Trump returned to office last year. 

(Reporting by Brad Brooks in Colorado; Additional reporting by Kanishka Singh in Washington; Editing by Donna Bryson and Michael Perry)

Taylor Swift will be the first recipient of the MTV Video Music Awards artist-director honours at this year's awards ceremony, a newly created award recognising musicians whose work behind the camera has contributed to music video production and visual storytelling, CBS and MTV said on Monday (Sep 21).
The television networks said the honor for the 14-time Grammy winner "celebrates a sustained and influential body of work from artists who have pushed creative boundaries and developed a clear directorial voice."
The MTV Video Music Awards, hosted by Snoop Dogg, will air live from Los Angeles on Sunday on CBS and MTV and stream on Paramount+ in the United States. The ceremony will be available internationally on Paramount+ and MTV the following day.
The singer-songwriter, a seven-time VMA Best Director nominee and four-time winner, has earned recognition for videos and films including The Fate Of Ophelia, Opalite and Anti-Hero.
Beyond her directing work, the Bad Blood singer has won four Grammy album of the year awards. Her latest release, The Life Of A Showgirl, sold more copies than any other album in the modern era during its first week of release, according to Billboard, citing data from Luminate, a firm that tracks music sales.

items.title: Google fined US$463 million for breaching EU rule on location data
items.author: The Associated Press
items.summary: Google has been fined 403 million euros (US$463 million) for breaching the European Union’s strict privacy rules because it mishandled users’ location data, the bloc’s data privacy watchdog said ...
items.body: Google has been fined 403 million euros (US$463 million) for breaching the European Union’s strict privacy rules because it mishandled users’ location data, the bloc’s data privacy watchdog said Monday. Ireland’s Data Protection Commission said its investigation found Google did not lawfully or fairly process location data in users’ Web & App Activity, a Google setting that tracks browsing and search history, and in their Location History, a service that maps places they’ve been with their mobile phones. Regulators also found the company failed to be lawful, fair and transparent when it processed personal data in its Location Accuracy feature in the Android mobile operating system. Ireland is the lead regulator for Google in the 27-nation EU because the U.S. tech giant’s European headquarters is based in Dublin. The investigation, which opened six years ago, examined how Google applied the EU privacy rule book, known as the General Data Protection Regulation, from the time it took effect in 2018 until February 2020. “This case centers around historical policies that have since been updated,” Google said in a statement. ”From 2019 onwards, we’ve significantly evolved our practices and launched robust tools that make managing location data simple.” Regulators said that location data is a type of personal data that’s collected by Google and can be used to infer someone’s location. “Location data can bring both benefits and harms to individuals,” Deputy Commissioner Graham Doyle said. “It can greatly enhance the utility of online services, but it can also reveal a significant amount of information about an individual, including information that is inherently private.” It’s the fourth biggest EU privacy fine issued by the Irish watchdog, which has previously handed out bigger fines to TikTok and Meta, including a 1.2 billion euro fine for Meta. The regulator said it still has three other ongoing privacy investigations involving Google. The Associated Press

items.title: Giants fear QB Jaxson Dart sprained his left MCL
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart was knocked out of New York's Monday night game against the Los Angeles Rams due to a left knee injury, and NFL Network reported that he sprained his medial collateral ligament.
items.body:
Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart was knocked out of New York's Monday night game against the Los Angeles Rams due to a left knee injury, and NFL Network reported that he sprained his medial collateral ligament.
New York coach John Harbaugh, asked postgame about the report of an MCL sprain, replied, "We'll know more tomorrow. That's in the neighborhood of it, I would say. We'll get an MRI tomorrow and have a really good feel for it."
According to ESPN, Dart underwent X-rays that were negative.
Dart got hurt on New York's first possession of a 28-6 defeat in Inglewood, Calif., and he was ruled out for the night during the third quarter.
At halftime of ESPN's telecast, New York general manager Joe Schoen said Dart was "going to be OK."
Dart, 23, had his left knee appear to buckle after he was hit high by Byron Young and lower by Josaiah Stewart of the Rams on a third-down incomplete pass with 11:20 left in the opening quarter.
Dart immediately grabbed the knee but eventually was able to walk off the field. He was checked out in the medical tent on the sideline before he walked to the locker room under his own power a short time later.
Dart was 3 of 5 for 20 yards on the drive.
Jameis Winston entered as quarterback on New York's next possession, and he wound up 11 of 27 for 111 yards and an interception.
Dart is viewed as the Giants' franchise quarterback. He passed for 2,272 yards, 15 touchdowns and five interceptions in 14 games (12 starts) as a rookie last season. He also rushed for 487 yards and nine scores.
This year, Dart led New York to a season-opening win over the Dallas Cowboys on Sept. 13, completing 23 of 29 passes for 230 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Yen squeezed as hawkish turn grips central banks
items.author: Tom Westbrook
items.creator: Tom Westbrook
items.summary: The yen was under pressure on Tuesday as traders wagered that policymakers in Japan will struggle to keep up with a hawkish turn by global central banks, leaving the country's interest rates at a wide gap with major peers.
items.body:
The yen was under pressure on Tuesday as traders wagered that policymakers in Japan will struggle to keep up with a hawkish turn by global central banks, leaving the country's interest rates at a wide gap with major peers.
Moves were contained thanks to a holiday in Japan and because of the risk of intervention, after the Nikkei newspaper reported Japan [USN:L1N45A0NK TEXT:"checked dollar/yen rates"] on Friday. Such a move is often a precursor to stepping into the market.
After drifting lower on Monday, the yen slipped to 157.47 versus the dollar in the Asia session, while elsewhere the dollar fell slightly. The euro inched up to $1.1476 and sterling to $1.3383.
Aside from bouncing after the rate check report, the yen has been under pressure since a [USN:L1N459138 TEXT:"Bank of Japan"] interest rate hike on Friday came with two dovish dissents.
That contrasted with the [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"Federal Reserve"], which also hiked rates last week, and most other [USN:L6N45A0IG TEXT:"global central banks"] which are sounding hawkish and have markets pricing more increases this year.
"Unless the BOJ tightens policy more rapidly than the Federal Reserve, the approximately 275-basis-point US-Japan rate differential should continue to support yen-funded carry trades," said Carlos Casanova, senior Asia economist at Union Bancaire Privée, in a note to clients.
"We expect dollar/yen to rise to 160 by year-end before appreciating moderately to 156 by mid-2027."
Markets are pricing about a 30% chance that the BOJ hikes its benchmark short-term rate to 1.5% in October and a roughly 55% chance that the Fed will lift its funds rate window by 25 basis points to 4% to 4.25%.
Reserve Bank of Australia Governor [USN:L1N45E02Y TEXT:"Michele Bullock"] said upside risks to inflation may be materialising, given energy prices have stayed high, underlining wagers for a rate hike as soon as next week.
The Aussie dollar hovered at $0.7120, while the battered New Zealand dollar appeared to catch a boost from central bank chief remarks that traders took as hawkish.
Reserve Bank of New Zealand Governor [USN:L1N45E01O TEXT:"Anna Breman"] said if recent gains in oil prices persist, it would lead to somewhat higher inflation than previously forecast.
The kiwi rose about 0.4% from a near three-month low to $0.5736.
Markets have priced about 100 basis points of rate hikes over the next 12 months in New Zealand, but the kiwi has been weighed down because with the cash rate sitting at 2.75%, that still leaves it lagging the US.
Cryptocurrencies, which rallied strongly on Monday, eased slightly. Bitcoin was down around 2% after touching an 8-month high above $87,000.

items.title: サッカー＝エムバペ、仏代表でジダン監督の指揮受けるのは「映画のよう」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - サッカーのフランス代表ＦＷキリアン・エムバペは、同国代表の新監督に就任したジネディーヌ・ジダン氏の指揮を受けることについて「映画のようだ」と語った。

ジダン監督はレアル・マドリードを退任して以来、５年ぶりに現場復帰。今回の国際Ａマッチ期間で、エムバペと初めて代表チームでともに戦うことになる。

エムバペはスペイン紙ＡＳのインタビューで、少年時代からジダン監督が自身のキャリアに関わっていたと振り返り、「何年も前、最初に迎えに来て、レアルのトレーニング施設へ連れて行ってくれたのが彼だった。１３歳か１４歳の頃で、ずいぶん昔のことだ。そして今、彼が代表監督になった。映画のワンシーンのようだけど、最高レベルの監督だ」と話した。

ジダン監督は今夏のワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）後、かつてフランス代表でチームメートだったディディエ・デシャン前監督の後任に就任。デシャン氏は１４年間にわたって指揮を執った。

エムバペは「新しい監督の下で新たな段階に入る。われわれはこれまでデシャン監督しか経験していないので、全員にとって新しい経験になる。変化にはなるが、全てうまくいくと思う」と述べた。

２５日に行われる欧州ネーションズリーグのトルコ戦がジダン監督の初陣となり、その後にベルギー、イタリアとの試合も控えている。

items.title: Oil prices climb ahead of potential US-Iran talks
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Oil prices gained for the first time in five sessions on Tuesday as investors awaited developments on potential US-Iran talks at the United Nations General Assembly this week after more supplies emerged through the Strait of Hormuz over the weekend.
items.body:
Oil prices gained for the first time in five sessions on Tuesday as investors awaited developments on potential US-Iran talks at the United Nations General Assembly this week after more supplies emerged through the Strait of Hormuz over the weekend.
The Brent crude futures November contract rose $1.72, or 1.7%, to $102.06 a barrel at 0617 GMT. The WTI October contract, which expires on Tuesday, climbed $1.62, or 1.7%, to $97.4 a barrel.
The more actively traded November contract was up $1.28, or 1.4%, at $93.65 a barrel.
Tehran and Washington exchanged threats on [USN:L6N45C051 TEXT:"Sunday"], though US President Donald Trump said he would be open to meeting Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, who is expected to be in New York this week for the [USN:L8N45C0C3 TEXT:"UN meeting"].
"The move higher in WTI and the stronger open in Brent have the appearance of a typical short-covering bounce after the recent decline, rather than a fundamental shift," said Tim Waterer, chief market analyst at KCM Trade.
"Traders who were positioned for further downside are taking some risk off the table while the diplomatic narrative plays out."
Over the weekend, Iran also conveyed its conditions to mediators for re-engaging in negotiations, Al Jazeera reported, citing Iran's security chief, Mohsen Rezaei.
Waterer said oil prices were likely to remain range-bound and sensitive to headlines until there was either clear progress or a setback in diplomatic efforts between the US and Iran.
Middle East tensions remained [USN:L1N45D0B1 TEXT:"elevated"] after Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis said they attacked Riyadh and a Saudi Aramco facility in Yanbu and stepped up efforts to cut off Saudi-backed forces from the Red Sea coast.
China has privately urged Tehran to help [USN:L8N4590LF TEXT:"curb attacks"] by the Houthis, three Iranian sources said, after Saudi Arabia appealed to Beijing following a recent surge in the group's military operations.
Saudi Aramco has increased exports through the Strait of Hormuz after attacks on its East-West Pipeline forced it to halt some shipments through Yanbu. Around 14 million barrels of its crude oil were loaded on seven supertankers inside the Gulf on Sunday, [USN:L1N45D0LX TEXT:"tanker tracking"] data showed.
"Supply concerns are easing as shipments through the Strait of Hormuz reach a six-month high and Saudi Arabia works to restore its East-West pipeline ... Crude implied volatility eased 3.3% to 50.39, although it remains historically elevated," said Saxo Bank analysts in a client note.
Separately, an armed group [USN:L1N45D0ED TEXT:"closed valve seven"] on Libya's Sharara crude pipeline to Zawiya port on Monday, resulting in a significant decline in production at the Sharara oilfield, Libya's National Oil Corporation said in a statement.
Production at the field has fallen by around 200,000 barrels per day and is currently between 100,000 and 105,000 bpd, two engineers at the field told Reuters.

items.title: 中国外相、独外相と電話会談　ＥＵとの貿易戦争回避訴え
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [北京 ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[北京 ２２日 ロイター] -  中国の王毅外相は、ドイツのワーデフール外相と電話会談を行い、中国と欧州は包括的戦略パートナーであり、貿易戦争をすべきではないと伝えた。中国政府の声明で明らかになった。

ドイツは、過剰生産能力や通貨の過小評価を背景とする対中貿易の不均衡に懸念を表明してきた欧州連合（ＥＵ）域内の主要国の一つ。

中国外務省が２１日夜に発表した声明によると、王氏はワーデフール氏に対し、双方間の互恵的な協力を強化することは双方の利益に合致し、「正しい選択」だと指摘。

「中国とＥＵは包括的戦略パートナーであり、中国と欧州は貿易戦争をすべきではない」と述べた。

王氏はさらに、「中国は一貫して、双方が歩み寄り、対話と協議を通じて互いの懸念に対する解決策を見いだすことを提唱してきた」とした。

ドイツが理性的かつ実務的な姿勢を維持し、ＥＵ内で建設的な役割を果たして、自由貿易を擁護し、保護主義を拒否することを望むと語った。

ドイツ外務省は、両外相が、世界経済の安定は中国、ドイツ、欧州の利益になるとの認識で一致したとした。

同省はＸへの投稿で、「貿易関係は公正なルールと真に対等な競争条件に基づくものでなければならない」と表明した。

中国側の声明によると、両外相はイランやウクライナ、中国が領有権を主張する台湾の問題についても協議した。

王氏は、ドイツが中独関係と台湾海峡の平和・安定を維持するために具体的な行動を取り、ハイレベル交流に必要な条件を整えることを望むと述べた。

items.title: Seoul's green space is a battleground for its mayor and South Korea's president
items.author: Cynthia Kim
items.creator: Cynthia Kim
items.summary: A showdown over green space is pitting South Korean President Lee Jae Myung, who is trying to address a national housing crisis as his approval ratings slump, against Seoul's mayor, who is pushing to create a huge park in the capital.
items.body:
A showdown over green space is pitting South Korean President Lee Jae Myung, who is trying to address a national housing crisis as his approval ratings slump, against Seoul's mayor, who is pushing to create a huge park in the capital.
For Mayor Oh Se-hoon, the planned open area is needed to address Seoul's "greenery deficit", which requires cleanup of the 300-hectare (740-acre) site to address environmental flaws.
Oh told Reuters he would not surrender "a single centimetre" of the capital's largest planned park to the apartment towers that Lee wants to build as surging home prices batter the president's popularity.
"We remain at odds over Yongsan Park," Oh, who has led South Korea's dominant city on and off for 20 years, said in an interview. "I cannot agree under any circumstances to using it as a site for apartments."
POLITICAL FACE-OFF REFLECTS POLICY DILEMMA The Lee-Oh clash reflects a global urban-policy conundrum: how megacities can manage severe housing shortages without destroying their liveability and environmental health. With 16,000 people per square km (40,000 per square mile), Seoul is more densely packed than London, New York or Tokyo, putting a strain on both housing and greenery.
Lee's public approval has plunged in the past two months to a record low 37%, a Gallup Korea poll showed on Friday, with real-estate policy the biggest driver of disapproval. Seoul apartment prices climbed for a record 86 consecutive weeks through the first week of September, according to the Korea Real Estate Board.
Lee's centre-left Democratic Party swept most major local races in June elections but [USN:L1N42C023 TEXT:"suffered a notable setback"] with the conservative Oh winning another term as Seoul mayor, leaving the president's policies vulnerable to direct resistance and gridlock from the city government.
Oh, a two-time presidential aspirant from the opposition, is considered by political analysts to be a likely contender for the presidency in 2030, while Lee, elected last year, can serve only one five-year term as president. His party will have to defend his policy legacy in the next election.
The sprawling park site near the Han River that bisects Seoul was set to become a public park after more than a century as a military base, first for Japanese colonial occupiers and then for the US, South Korea's major postwar ally.
But in August, Lee proposed [USN:L1N44A06N TEXT:"building apartment towers"] in part of the area and stripping protections from Seoul's greenbelt zones and suburban golf courses to increase the land in the capital available for housing. Building houses on the park site would require action by the National Assembly as the space is protected by law.
CONGESTED 'CITY OF WATER AND MOUNTAINS' Lee acknowledged the strong criticism of his real-estate policies on Friday but stopped short of announcing any structural policy changes.
The land ministry said it would explore part of the area to "provide affordable housing for young people and future generations," stressing that the project will only move forward after establishing a public consensus.
The presidential office referred questions about the matter to the land ministry.
Oh is among many who [USN:L1N3UU00X TEXT:"blame mortgage curbs"] and higher taxes introduced by Lee for the housing crisis, arguing that reduced borrowing power has failed to cool housing demand and instead pushed up rents.
Loan curbs disproportionately hurt young, first-time buyers because "wealthy individuals who hold plenty of cash find it even easier to purchase homes, whereas young people who do not have immediate cash completely lose the opportunity to buy their very first home," the mayor said.
The land ministry said the country needs to regulate mortgages to curb excessive debt, but it has recently eased borrowing rules for young, first-time homebuyers.
Asked why the park mattered so much to Seoul residents, Oh described the capital as "a city of water and mountains" that nonetheless thirsts for green space, with 60% of citizens living in apartment buildings.
In addition to the river, Seoul is ringed by four inner peaks and four outer peaks, so residents can easily see greenery in the distance.
But green space that people can experience daily — on their work commute, for example — is a different matter, Oh said, adding that Seoul residents have just a fourth of the greenery that Londoners enjoy.

items.title: South Korea confirms first project under $350 billion US investment pact despite viability concerns
items.author: Heejin Kim, Jihoon Lee, Joyce Lee
items.creator: Heejin Kim, Jihoon Lee, Joyce Lee
items.summary: South Korea confirmed its first project under a $350 billion US investment pact on Tuesday and said it is considering two others, moving ahead despite profitability concerns and criticism from President Donald Trump over the pace of implementation.
items.body:
South Korea confirmed its first project under a $350 billion US investment pact on Tuesday and said it is considering two others, moving ahead despite profitability concerns and criticism from President Donald Trump over the pace of implementation.
Seoul has selected a gas-fired power plant project in Texas, while also considering a proposal to invest in two South Korean-designed nuclear reactors as part of a broader nuclear investment initiative, lawmaker Chung Chin-ook said on the sidelines of a briefing by Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan.
Kim briefed lawmakers in a closed-door meeting as Seoul and Washington seek to finalise implementation of a trade deal agreed in November last year that cut US tariffs on South Korean goods to 15%.
The investment plans require approval by a US government investment committee and further negotiation with US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, Kim told Reuters after the briefing. Trump would make the final announcement on the US investment plan, news agency Yonhap reported.
TRUMP THREATS US officials have criticised Seoul for moving too slowly on the investments, especially compared with countries such as Japan and Trump had threatened higher tariffs as a result.
Seoul wants to avoid further friction with Washington after Trump also criticised South Korea for not [USN:L1N45A025 TEXT:"providing assistance"] over the Iran war and US officials aired concerns over the treatment of US companies, including [USN:L6N43J0JL TEXT:"US-listed Coupang"] (CPNG.N) .
President Lee Jae Myung said on Friday that [USN:L1N45A039 TEXT:"commercial viability"] had become a sticking point as negotiators moved from a broad agreement to the details of individual projects and Seoul had sought to ensure "commercially reasonable" investments.
"The announcement of the first project would be a meaningful initial step," said Hyun Jung Je, a Washington-based senior fellow at policy group Korea Economic Institute of America.
"It would demonstrate that the two governments have made progress in identifying an investment opportunity that they believe can serve the interests of both countries. Ultimately, the deal will need to be judged by its implementation and results, rather than the commitment itself."
POWER AND NUCLEAR PROJECTS South Korea is also considering the purchase of a 5% to 10% stake in US nuclear technology firm Westinghouse, while a decision on participating in a long-delayed Alaska liquefied natural gas project had not yet been made, Chung said.
The confirmed project - a 6.3-gigawatt gas-fired power plant in Encinal, Texas - is valued at more than $20 billion and would supply electricity to AI data centres and chip factories, according to media reports.
The two countries have also been discussing construction of as many as eight large nuclear reactors in the United States, two of which would be built using Korea's APR1400 model while the remaining six will deploy Westinghouse's AP1000 design, a source briefed on the negotiations said.
A separate source also said South Korea was seeking to cap annual investment at $20 billion to limit the potential impact on the won's exchange rate .
Lawmaker Bae Jun-young said a "significant" payment would be required by the end of September after a formal announcement.
Funds could be remitted within 45 days if requested by Washington, Yonhap reported. South Korea will provide the full investment for a gas-fired power project in Texas while ownership would be split equally with US partners, the news agency also reported.
Kim Yong-jin, management professor at Sogang University, said the Texas power plant project could help other Korean companies enter the US market with their technologies.
A deal to build Korean-designed nuclear reactors and secure a stake of around 10% in Westinghouse would also help South Korea protect its intellectual property, he said.
"That will be the best-case scenario because there is a high possibility that it will open up markets in Europe and the Middle East as well."
COMMERCIAL VIABILITY CONCERNS Lawmakers from the opposition conservative party told reporters they had raised concerns about the commercial viability of the investments but the government had told them it believed the Texas project would be viable under a 20-year profit-return structure.
The lawmakers have demanded closer [USN:L4N45D0B1 TEXT:"parliamentary scrutiny"] of the projects. The government does not need parliamentary approval but does need to brief the chamber about projects deemed commercially reasonable.
Projects that are not commercially feasible, but that the government wants to pursue on national security grounds or for supply chain stability, would require parliamentary consent, according to the South Korean bill on US strategic investment.

items.title: EXCLUSIVE-米、グリーンランドに軍事拠点2カ所開設へ＝関係筋
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Stine Jacobsen　Erin Banco　Gram Slattery

[コペンハーゲン／ワシントン ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Stine Jacobsen　Erin Banco　Gram Slattery

[コペンハーゲン／ワシントン ２１日 ロイター] - 米国は、デンマークおよび同国の自治領グリーンランドと２２日に署名する協定に基づき、グリーンランド南部にある冷戦時代の旧軍事基地を再開するとともに、現在デンマークの犬ぞりパトロール部隊が使用している東海岸の基地に軍事拠点を設ける計画だ。事情に詳しい関係者３人が明らかにした。

対象となるのは、ナルサルスアークとメステルスビの２カ所。ナルサルスアークは、米国が１９５０年代に軍事基地「ブルーイ・ウェスト・ワン」を閉鎖して以降、人口が数十人にまで減少している。メステルスビは、デンマークの特殊部隊であるシリウス犬ぞりパトロール隊が現在使用している軍事拠点だという。

デンマーク、グリーンランド、米国は２２日午前１０時半（日本時間午後１１時半）、ニューヨークの国連総会の場で新たな協定に署名する見通し。

協定の文面は公表されておらず、関係者によると、詳細は署名されるまで確定しない。

デンマークとグリーンランド両政府はコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。ホワイトハウスも直ちには応じなかった。

デンマークは、この協定によって北極圏の安全保障が米国とデンマークだけに委ねられるのではなく、軍事同盟である北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の監視下に置かれることになると説明している。

items.title: Ｆ１＝2027年からレース距離短縮へ、305キロから290キロに
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 国際自動車連盟（ＦＩＡ）のＦ１委員会は２１日、２０２７年から通常のグランプリ（ＧＰ）のレース距離を３０５キロから２９０キロに短縮することで合意した。各レースで２─３周程度少なくなる。

ロンドンで開かれた会合後の声明によると、２０２７年のパワーユニット規則で予定されている燃料流量に関する改定に合わせた措置。

また、雨などによる中断を含め、レース開始から終了まで現在設けられている３時間の上限を撤廃することでも合意した。実際の走行時間については２時間の上限を維持する一方、中断が発生したレースでは競技終了時刻に明確な上限を設ける。

ＦＩＡは、中断が発生した際にも観客が可能な限り完全な形でレースを楽しめるようにすることが目的と説明している。

フリー走行が中断された場合、主催者がセッション時間を延長できるよう、より大きな裁量を持たせることでも合意した。

items.title: China and Europe should not fight trade wars, Chinese foreign minister says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: China and Europe should not fight trade wars because the pair are comprehensive strategic partners, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi told his German counterpart in a call, according to a statement from Beijing.
items.body:
China and Europe should not fight trade wars because the pair are comprehensive strategic partners, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi told his German counterpart in a call, according to a statement from Beijing.
Germany has been one of the leading voices in the EU expressing concern about unbalanced trade with China due to industrial overcapacity and an undervalued currency.
Wang told German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul that strengthening mutually beneficial bilateral cooperation aligns with both sides' interests and represents the "right choice", China's foreign ministry said late on Monday.
"China and the EU are comprehensive strategic partners; China and Europe should not fight trade wars," a statement from the ministry cited Wang as saying.
"China has consistently advocated that both sides move toward each other and find solutions to each other's concerns through dialogue and consultation," he added.
China hopes Germany maintains a rational and pragmatic approach and plays a positive role within the EU, promoting the upholding of free trade and rejecting protectionism, Wang said.
Germany's foreign ministry said the two ministers agreed that a stable global economy is in China's, Germany's and Europe's interest.
"Trade relations have to be based on fair rules and a real level playing field," it said on social media platform X.
The two ministers also discussed Iran, Ukraine and the issue of Chinese-claimed Taiwan, the Chinese statement added.
China hopes Germany takes concrete action to maintain Chinese-German relations and peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait, creating necessary conditions for high-level exchanges, Wang said.
Taiwan has increased its engagement with European countries, with [USN:L1N45301R TEXT:"Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim"] making two trips to the continent in the last year, angering China.
Taiwanese Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung made a rare visit to Germany in June that he did not reveal until the following month.
Taiwan's democratically elected government rejects Beijing's sovereignty claims.

items.title: 北朝鮮、20日に新型兵器試験成功　金総書記「敵に不治の頭痛」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Heejin Kim

[ソウル ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Heejin Kim

[ソウル ２２日 ロイター] - 北朝鮮国営の朝鮮中央通信（ＫＣＮＡ）は２２日、金正恩朝鮮労働党総書記の立ち会いの下、ミサイル総局が２０日に「超近代的な防衛技術」を示す新型兵器の試験を実施し成功したと伝えた。金氏は戦争準備態勢の強化に向けた進展を称賛したという。

金氏は今回の試験について、軍の戦闘能力における著しい発展を示すものだとし、「敵はそうした進展が何を意味するか、説明しなくとも、よりよく理解するだろう」と語った。

「こうした現実は敵に不治の頭痛をもたらし、極めて残酷で回避不能な打撃を与えることになる」と述べた。

ＫＣＮＡの報道では、兵器の具体的な種類には言及していない。

ＫＣＮＡが公開した写真には、金氏が１０代の娘を伴い、東岸の地図と「火星砲１１マ１型」の「飛行軌跡」を映し出したスクリーンを見ている様子が写っていた。このミサイルは、北朝鮮が改良を進めている一連の短距離弾道ミサイルの一つとみられる。

北朝鮮情勢を専門とするソウル拠点のウェブサイト「ＮＫニュース」は、この飛翔体が極超音速滑空体を搭載したミサイルの改良型とみられると指摘した。

滑空体をミサイルに搭載することで、弾頭はミサイル防衛を回避する機動が可能となり、部分的に軌道上に打ち上げられる可能性もある。

韓国軍は２０日、北朝鮮が東岸沖に向けて短距離弾道ミサイル２発を発射したと発表していた。

北朝鮮は先週、米国主導の多国間軍事演習が朝鮮半島の緊張激化の「主な原因」だと非難した。

韓国外務省によると、日米韓の外相は２１日、ニューヨークで開かれている国連総会に合わせて会談し、朝鮮半島の平和と安定、非核化に向けて緊密に連携していくことで一致した。

items.title: ¿Modelo o advertencia? Milei divide a Lula y Bolsonaro en la recta final de las elecciones de Brasil
items.author: Martha Beck
items.summary: El candidato de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro presentó la reforma económica del presidente argentino como un ejemplo de la disciplina fiscal que, según él, necesita Brasil.
items.body: Bloomberg — A dos semanas de unas reñidas elecciones presidenciales, los principales candidatos de Brasil han convertido a la Argentina de Javier Milei en un reflejo de sus propias visiones económicas contrapuestas. El candidato de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro presenta la reforma económica del presidente argentino como un ejemplo de la disciplina fiscal que, según él, necesita Brasil, mientras sostiene unas tijeras como una versión más modesta de la famosa motosierra de Milei. Ver más: Lula y Bolsonaro quedan en empate técnico en una encuesta a semanas de las elecciones de Brasil La campaña del presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defiende la postura contraria, señalando la desaceleración económica de Argentina y las tensiones en el mercado laboral como una advertencia de lo que podría esperar a los trabajadores brasileños si Bolsonaro gana. Milei ha desempeñado un papel fundamental en la política brasileña desde que llegó a la presidencia de Argentina hace tres años. Su propuesta de austeridad fiscal y reformas a favor del mercado lo convirtió en un rival económico natural de Lula, quien desde hace tiempo considera que el gasto público es crucial para el crecimiento. El respaldo de Lula al rival de Milei en las elecciones de 2023 también los convirtió en adversarios políticos, y el argentino le devolvió el favor este año, con una ofensiva de ataques contra el mandatario brasileño durante un acto de campaña de Bolsonaro que provocó una disputa diplomática entre ambos países. El último capítulo de su disputa se ha desarrollado en foros de inversores y anuncios digitales, con ambas campañas apostando a que el experimento de “terapia de choque” de Milei puede ayudar a definir la elección que enfrentan los votantes en la economía más grande de América Latina. Las encuestas muestran un empate técnico de cara a la primera vuelta del 4 de octubre, a la que probablemente seguirá una segunda vuelta tres semanas después. “Nos inspiraremos en lo que ha hecho el gobierno de Javier Milei en Argentina”, dijo Daniella Marques, la principal asesora económica de la campaña de Bolsonaro, en un evento la semana pasada. “Milei es un gran ejemplo en lo que respecta a la recuperación de la capacidad de inversión, la reducción de la burocracia y la reducción de impuestos”. Se trataba de un mensaje dirigido a los inversores, cada vez más preocupados por el deterioro de la situación fiscal de Brasil bajo el mandato de Lula, y que siguen ansiosos por conocer los detalles sobre cómo abordaría Bolsonaro esta cuestión. Pero el Partido de los Trabajadores de Lula aprovechó la oportunidad y publicó un video en las redes sociales que señalaba la pérdida sustancial de empleos y el cierre de empresas en Argentina como consecuencias del modelo económico de Milei. Ver más: Las 10 acciones que prefiere Citi si gana Lula o Bolsonaro en las elecciones de Brasil La capacidad de Milei para reducir la inflación, que había alcanzado cifras de tres dígitos, al tiempo que eliminaba el déficit fiscal, recortaba la burocracia regulatoria y aprobaba una importante reforma laboral, le ha convertido en uno de los favoritos de los inversores. También es un ejemplo recurrente para los candidatos conservadores que proponen políticas similares —y ganan elecciones— en toda América. Bolsonaro es el último: durante toda la campaña, ha abogado por un tesouraço, o gran recorte, del gasto público brasileño. “Si Argentina tuvo la motosierra, Brasil tendrá unas tijeras enormes para los impuestos, la burocracia y la corrupción”, dijo Bolsonaro tras reunirse con Milei a principios de este año. Sin embargo, la otra cara de la moneda está proporcionando ahora munición a oponentes como Lula. La economía argentina se contrajo en el segundo trimestre, y el progreso contra la inflación ahora se encuentra con la frustración de los votantes por el desempleo en una nación que ha perdido 246.000 puestos de trabajo asalariados en el sector privado —alrededor del 4% del total— desde que asumió el cargo. La popularidad de Milei se situó en el 38% en agosto, mientras que alrededor del 70% de los argentinos calificaron de deficiente el mercado laboral del país en una encuesta de AtlasIntel realizada para Bloomberg News. Ver más: Carrera presidencial en Brasil se vuelve más reñida mientras Bolsonaro gana impulso ante Lula Los aliados de Lula también han aprovechado esta situación para destacar su propuesta estrella de campaña: una reducción de la jornada laboral semanal. El Partido de los Trabajadores contrastó este plan con una disposición de la reforma laboral de Milei que pretendía flexibilizar la semana laboral: el cambio permite a los empleados trabajar hasta 12 horas al día —frente al límite anterior de ocho— a cambio de jornadas más cortas o días libres posteriores. Bolsonaro ha abogado por unas normas laborales más flexibles para contrarrestar la propuesta de Lula, argumentando que ello daría a los trabajadores más libertad para negociar en un momento en el que muchos están optando por trabajos esporádicos a través de aplicaciones en lugar de los empleos tradicionales. El senador de derecha y sus aliados lograron frustrar una votación sobre el plan de reforma laboral de Lula antes de las elecciones, impidiendo así la aprobación de una propuesta que cuenta con un gran apoyo entre los votantes brasileños. --Con la colaboración de Manuela Tobias. items.title: OpenAI、米国に取り組みの主導求める－AIの国際基準策定で
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米OpenAIは、最先端のAIの国際基準策定に向け、米国が他国・地域と連携して取り組みを主導するよう求めている。AIがもたらす可能性のある弊害への懸念の高まりに対応する。

OpenAIは21日のブログ投稿で、AIを安全に開発するには国際的な技術基準が必要だと指摘。特に、AIモデルに関連するどのような事案を報告対象とすべきかを定義し、AIの進歩に向けて各国・地域がどう協力できるかを定め、こうした技術の開発に必要なコンピューティング能力へのアクセスを改善する上で重要だとした。

OpenAIは「AIの継続的な進歩を安全で有益なものにするには、アラインメント（人間の意図や価値観に沿わせる）研究の進展と、研究機関や国をまたいだ開発の指針となる共通基準の両方が必要になる」としている。

同社によると、サム・アルトマン最高経営責任者（CEO）は23日、国連安全保障理事会でAIと国際安全保障について演説する予定で、24日には中国の習近平国家主席を迎えてホワイトハウスで開かれる国賓夕食会に出席する。

OpenAIはブログ投稿で、こうした取り組みには各国が協力し、最も高性能なAIモデルの開発に向けて相互に補完し合う国内基準と国際基準を策定することを含むべきだと強調。同社は、米商務省内の組織で、AIモデルの試験や指針策定を支援するAI標準・イノベーションセンター（CAISI）など、各国に既に設置されているAI安全機関を通じて実現できるとの考えを示した。

ブログではまた、AIが自律的に作業を遂行する能力が高まっていることに対応するための基準も必要だと訴えた。人間の介入なしにAIが最終的に自らのコードを変更したり、その他の方法で能力を向上させたりできるようになるという理論を指す「完全自律型」の「再帰的自己改善（RSI）」について、「安全に実行できるようになるまでは」追求すべきではないとした。

items.author: CNA
items.summary: Washington on Monday also stressed the need for military and economic investment in the Arctic to safeguard the region.

US to open two new military bases in Greenland: Sources

Washington on Monday also stressed the need for military and economic investment in the Arctic to safeguard the region. 

The Greenland flag flutters in front of a house in Nuuk, Greenland, on Sep 19, 2026. (File photo: Reuters/Tim Barsoe)

COPENHAGEN: The US plans to reopen a former Cold War-era military base in southern Greenland and set up a military presence at an east coast base now used by the Danish dog sled patrol under an agreement to be signed by the US, Denmark and Greenland on Tuesday (Sep 22), according to three people familiar with the matter.
Those sites are Narsarsuaq, whose population has dwindled to a few dozen people since the US closed its Bluie West One military base in the 1950s, and Mestersvig, a military outpost currently used by the Sirius Dog Sled Patrol, a Danish special forces unit, said two of the people.
Denmark, Greenland and the United States are expected to sign their new agreement at the United Nations General Assembly in New York City at 2.30pm GMT (10.30pm, Singapore time) on Tuesday.
The text of the agreement has not been made public and the three people familiar with the deal, speaking on condition of anonymity, said its details are not finalised until it is signed.

The governments of Denmark and Greenland did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The White House also did not immediately respond.
Denmark says the agreement puts Arctic security under the watch of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization, the military defence alliance, rather than leaving it solely to the US and Denmark.
The deal follows months of pressure from US President Donald Trump, who has long said he wants the US to control Greenland and had at times refused to rule out military or economic force to acquire the semi-autonomous Danish territory.
Trump's threats, which peaked in January, triggered a diplomatic crisis within NATO and pushed Denmark and Greenland into negotiations with Washington aimed at defusing the pressure.
During the Cold War, the US maintained 17 military installations and more than 10,000 personnel in Greenland. Today only Pituffik Space Base remains, with some 150 US military personnel.

Related:

US and Denmark reach deal on Greenland, Trump says

Denmark hails 'binding' Greenland deal with Trump

US STRESSES NEED FOR INVESTMENT IN ARCTIC  US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Monday also stressed the need for investment in the Arctic while meeting with his counterparts from seven countries in the region.
"Allies agreed that Arctic security requires continued investment to safeguard this vital region and deter strategic competitors," State Department spokesman Tommy Piggott said in a readout of the meeting.
"Discussions focused on taking greater responsibility for Arctic security by developing sovereign military and economic capabilities, ensuring investment security, and funding resilient critical infrastructure that ensures reliable access and supports our shared leadership in the Arctic."
The meeting convened top diplomats from Canada, Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway, Sweden, the Faroe Islands and Greenland, at a New York hotel on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly.
Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen said the agreement that would be signed on Tuesday recognises the sovereignty and territorial integrity of Denmark, and the right of self-determination for Greenland's people.
Washington said the agreement paves the way to strengthen US military presence in Greenland while ensuring that China and Russia will not be able to establish bases or carry out sensitive investments there without consent.
Monday's discussions also touched on cooperation to develop a fleet of icebreakers between the US, Canada and Finland.
In October, the United States announced the purchase of 11 icebreakers from Finland for the US Coast Guard to add to its fleet of three aging ships.
European Union foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said recently that Europe needs icebreakers to strengthen its presence in the Arctic, as global warming draws the interest of major powers to the region.
Vast natural resources are becoming increasingly accessible in the Arctic as ice melts and new maritime routes open up due to climate change.
China, Russia and the United States are reinforcing their presence in the strategic Arctic as a result.
